completed_evidence.scope: Read-only source, state-history, and logout evidence verification; no new HTTP

limitations: MP3 retains its original overall harness failure at return_home. Its core audio journey and UI logout passed; the retained Home DOM establishes that the final global album-title uniqueness assumption was wrong.
The old MP3 SPA hash route was not recorded and remains unknown. Only the later FLAC run records the actual #!/home route.

FLAC selects the unique album title within the observed Latest Music section. Its album card did not expose data-id; this is not represented as an observed album DOM ID. The track row/currentSrc and the Home Music library card have their recorded identity evidence.
Both runs retain Similar/ThemeMedia HTTP404 and two page errors each. These auxiliary compatibility gaps are separate from the passed audio journey.
HTTP MIME and real HTMLMediaElement state do not measure physical audible output or the decoder output codec. No successful media response body was read.

The proxy transport does not establish HTTP keepalive compatibility. Instance pins surround explicitly frozen targets; the independent logout check is not atomically cancellable across unexpected instance replacement.
The root task runs the independent full product suite and owns the main deployment decision; this report makes no full-suite or production-deployment claim.
